title: SAGE findings
description: The agent's final result for one run, written to runs/<run-id>/findings.json. report.md is generated from it. Beyond this schema, sage.findings checks that ranks are 1..n, that run_id names the run directory, and that every artifact path exists inside that directory.

run_id.description: Name of the run directory this result belongs to.

status.description: bottlenecks_found needs at least one finding. inconclusive may have none, or only tentative ones.

summary.description: A few sentences: what limits performance, or why the analysis was inconclusive.

limitations.description: What could not be measured or checked (e.g. no hardware counters).

rank.description: Priority order: 1 is the most important finding. Ranks must be 1..n with no gaps or repeats.

function.description: Symbol as perf reports it, e.g. ljForce.

source_location.description: path:line or path:first-last, relative to the source checkout, e.g. src-mpi/ljForce.c:139-188.

supporting_evidence.description: Concrete observations, each citing measured numbers.

experiment.description: What was run to test the hypothesis (command or change of input).

experiment_result.description: What it showed, and whether it confirmed the hypothesis.

artifact_paths.description: Files or directories in the run directory that hold the evidence, relative to it (e.g. perf-report.txt, annotate/ljForce.txt, experiments/size-40/perf-stat.txt).
